home.pitch: The first AI Consensus Platform that combines the best reasoning from multiple AI models into one transparent answer.

strategyHint.max_accuracy: Prioritise verified facts and cite consensus above novelty.
strategyHint.balanced: Even weight on accuracy, nuance and clarity.
strategyHint.creative: Reward unexpected framings and lateral connections.
strategyHint.critical: Actively surface counter-arguments and edge cases.
strategyHint.fast: Shortest defensible answer with the top argument.

home.emptyError: Ask something first — the referee can't judge silence.
home.howTitle: From your question to a conclusion you can trust
home.howBody: Every step is transparent — you always see what the models agreed on, disagreed on, and why.
home.modelsTitle: The world's best AIs, in the same room
home.modelsBody: Referee sends your question to each in parallel — and only shows you what they agree on.

evidence.title: Evidence Review
evidence.body: Claims are checked for logical consistency.

trust.title: Trust Scores
trust.body: Each claim earns a defensible confidence value.

home.featureAbody: GPT and Gemini reason on your question in parallel. Claude, Grok and Mistral are on the roadmap.
home.featureBbody: Every conclusion ships with a consensus level and a defensible confidence score.
home.featureCbody: One click asks every model to try to refute the conclusion — and update it.

reuse.title: You've asked something similar before.
reuse.subtitle: Referee found a prior Trusted Conclusion that overlaps with your question. Reuse it for an instant answer, or run a fresh multi-model comparison to update it.
reuse.caveat: Reused conclusions cite the original model responses. Refreshing charges a full multi-model comparison and overwrites the cache.

settings.title: Preferences
settings.reuseHint: Referee caches prior Trusted Conclusions and offers to reuse them when you ask a similar question.
settings.prefAskHint: Referee will show the Reusable Consensus screen every time a match is found.
settings.prefFreshHint: Skip the reuse prompt and run a new multi-model comparison by default.
settings.prefReusedHint: Automatically reuse a matching prior conclusion when one exists within the cache window.
settings.prefSensitiveHint: Always run fresh comparisons for financial, legal, medical and current-event topics. Other topics may still be reused.

results.whyBody: Every claim is sorted by how much support it earned from the models. Nothing is hidden.
results.contributionTitle: How each model shaped the conclusion
results.whyChoseAnswer: Why did AI Referee choose this answer?
results.noConclusion: The Trusted Conclusion is not available for this reused answer. Refresh with a new comparison to generate it.
results.rationaleBody: Three concise explanations for why this conclusion beats every alternative Referee considered.
